context: A police officer discusses cultural-property cases
purpose: Teach: 病状/横綱/法王/君臨/演目/直訳/装い/床下

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 被害者の、本気で、絶対、病状、絶対、警察、絶対、慎重に、絶対、確認、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're being very careful to confirm the victim's condition. Thank you for your patience.
lines.style: Measured, official but not cold. Steady eye contact. Precise diction on key terms. Slight formal bow in the voice—professional respect without distance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 相撲の、本気で、絶対、横綱、絶対、関連の、絶対、警備、絶対、警察、絶対、ご担当、絶対、ですか、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Are you handling the security arrangements for the sumo tournament, or is that someone else's division?
lines.style: Curious but deferential. Leans slightly forward. Genuine question—not testing, just trying to understand the chain of responsibility. Light, open tone.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。海外の、本気で、絶対、法王、絶対、来日警備、絶対、警察、絶対、準備、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We prepared extensively for the papal visit security detail when he came to Japan.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, confident. Clean syllables on procedural terms. The tone of someone explaining work they've done well. No pride, just clarity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地下組織、本気で、絶対、君臨、絶対、している、絶対、首領、絶対、警察、絶対、捜査対象ですか、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Is the underground organization's leader currently a person of interest in your investigation?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before the question. Careful with phrasing—respectful of the officer's position. Genuinely working through the problem aloud, not accusatory.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。劇場の、本気で、絶対、演目、絶対、警察、絶対、警備、絶対、ご相談、絶対、伺っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're gathering witness statements about the suspect's appearance in connection with the theater incident.
lines.style: Straightforward procedural update. Brisk but not rushed. The tone of someone ticking through necessary details. Professional warmth—not cold, just efficient.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 海外の容疑者、本気で、絶対、供述、絶対、直訳、絶対、で、絶対、解釈に、絶対、注意が必要ですよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: When statements come from overseas suspects, literal translation can be misleading—interpretation needs real attention to context, doesn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. Not lecturing—offering observation as a peer. Slight rise on the question tag, inviting agreement. Smart but not showing off.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。容疑者の、本気で、絶対、装い、絶対、警察、絶対、目撃情報、絶対、集めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're collecting witness descriptions of the suspect's clothing and appearance.
lines.style: Consistent with earlier procedural tone. Even pacing. Slight emphasis on 'collecting'—ongoing work. Professional and unfussy.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 古民家の、本気で、絶対、床下、絶対、隠し物、絶対、警察、絶対、捜索、絶対、対象、絶対、になることありますね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Old houses sometimes have spaces under the floorboards where things can be hidden—somewhere your search might turn up something useful, right?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost conversational. Gentle suggestion rather than direction. Trailing rise at the end—collaborative thinking, not instruction. The tone of someone offering a lead, not presuming.
